item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
So so glad that this has its own page now. Many of these has made me lol hard c:

I have a question, though:

Polandball has a huge following on various social media and there's bound to be people who are familiar with it on this website. It's possible someone could come up with a GOIball comic other than SunnyParallax. I know a collaboration tag isn't present at the bottom, and this is Sunny's work. What about other fans of the original meme, should they [want to] create and submit their work? With staff and/or Sunny's permission and clearance of course.

However, this would be a real collab instead of Sunny's own GOIball page if that happens. If it's not part of the intention to let others contribute, I'm cool with that.

item.title: Re: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
As far as I can tell, Rainbow Foundationball is on the page because Sunny drew it and it's a Foundationball thing, and this is a page for Foundationball things Sunny drew.

This page does not speak for the entirety of the site, staff, members, etc. nor is it expected to. This is a page for Sunny to display her work.

That is the sort of emotionally neutral response I was looking for. Thank you for clarifying everything - all good here, now that the concerns about the rules are cleared up.

E: One last thing: I would like links to the outreach sites specified, as is said in my reply to Procyon.

item.title: Re: uh, staff
item.content:encoded:
Coordinated pro-Marriage equality messages on all the official outreach sites, with both tacit and explicit staff/admin approval.

Understood - thank you for clarifying. Would you please provide a link to those? I can't find them by means of Google or links, but I know I'm just missing them.

This, to most of the site's audience, is not a controversial thing.

Yes, I've gathered. That didn't change the fact that I had concerns about regulations.

item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
If this is supposed to be a part of Sunny's author page somehow, or something similar, and there's no rule against personal politics being shown in that manner, then of course I'm all good with that.

Sunny's got quite a lot of art pages on the site, plus her own hub.

I've always felt that the pages were just up to display cool art done by Sunny. As far as I can tell, Rainbow Foundationball is on the page because Sunny drew it and it's a Foundationball thing, and this is a page for Foundationball things Sunny drew. That's the extent of it, no contract to sign/implications of the site as a whole/bringing up of issues necessary.

This page does not speak for the entirety of the site, staff, members, etc. nor is it expected to.
This is a page for Sunny to display her work.

item.title: Re: uh, staff
item.content:encoded:
Coordinated pro-Marriage equality messages on all the official outreach sites, with both tacit and explicit staff/admin approval.
In addition, this is well within SunnyParallax's rights as a user. This, to most of the site's audience, is not a controversial thing.

item.title: Re: uh, staff
item.content:encoded:
Well, that was professional. Could you please link me to the rules you're referencing?

E: Also, could you please answer my questions regarding site policy? That's what I was asking of a staff member.

item.title: Re: uh, staff
item.content:encoded:
I think the official line is "deal with it".
That's my official line at least.

item.title: uh, staff
item.content:encoded:
I upvoted, but

rainbow flag

I thought we had a fairly strict 'no bringing up heated socio-political issues' rule, staff, and with no explanation, I'm pretty sure the rainbow flag Foundationball is about the gay rights movement. Otherwise it would say 'rainbow' without 'flag.'

Seriously, I'm all for freedom of speech in every single aspect, but I'm not comfortable with everyone on this site/in this culture being represented by that when we don't know for a fact that every site member supports what it represents. I mean, it's nothing but the rainbow flag over the Foundation logo. What else could it mean? This concerns me deeply (this site has always been apolitical, and I loved it) so I hope a staffer comes by soon. Thank you.

E: and let me quote this before someone else does:

All of them are based on personal understanding of GOIs, or are simply for fun, thus don't need to be taken seriously.

Let me clarify that I am asking about site rules regarding politics. If this is supposed to be a part of Sunny's author page somehow, or something similar, and there's no rule against personal politics being shown in that manner, then of course I'm all good with that.

GOI Ball comics, original forum thread: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-1009829/goi-ball-comic
